verdict.rationale: Motion offers bookable scheduling (embedded booking calendar) and meeting templates that can include "reminders," so some booking reminders exist. The single mention gives no detail on channel, timing, or automation around each booking. Missing for 10: confirmed email reminder delivery to invitees, SMS reminders, multi-step reminder/follow-up sequences, post-booking follow-up automation, no-show reduction evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
